shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat panel/slab
repeated rows of elongated parallel elements (feather-like fringe / zigzag band)
justification: Both are shallow relief compositions that combine profile zoomorphic heads, small round bosses and rows of repeated elongated marks, and both taper into a narrower lower zone, which gives a faint family resemblance. But A is a single, densely ornamented, bilaterally symmetric anthropomorphic figure filling the whole field with fine incised detail, while B is a coarse, sparsely carved stone divided into stacked horizontal registers of isolated animals — the organising logic and the handling of surface are quite different.
